title: Dialog
description: A modal dialog for interactive compositions: a scrim over the frame, a soft panel with an optional kit-icon, a title, a multi-line body and one or two tactile buttons. Confirm emits confirm (Enter too), cancel emits cancel (Escape too); the scrim is a hit region under the panel, so nothing below takes a tap while it is open, and a tap on it emits cancel (or nothing). Springs in when its item appears, when the clip sends it open, or when a bound `open` turns true; sinks out when `open` turns false; shakes on shake. Buttons stack for thumbs on a vertical frame and sit side by side on a wide one. Takes a theme.

title.description: The question or the news (empty: none)

body.default: Your score is kept for today. You can come back and finish this round later.
body.description: What it means; several lines are fine (empty: none)

cancel.description: The cancel button's label (empty: one button)

icon.description: A kit-icon name in a tinted circle above the title (empty: none)

tone.description: Colour of the confirm button and the icon: the accent, red for a destructive choice, green for good news

open.description: Shown or not: bind it to a boolean to animate it in and out (leave `when` out then)

scrimTap.description: A tap on the scrim: emits cancel; is swallowed (emits block); or goes through to what is under it (not modal)

width.description: Panel width in % of the frame's short side (never wider than the box)

size.description: Title size in % of the frame's short side (the body is about two thirds of it)

buttonSize.description: Button height in % of the frame's short side

outDur.description: Seconds it takes to sink out when `open` turns false
